rejection: An exact signed-offset mask removed the sign branch at both encoder call sites, but the one complete warm encode screen showed no useful gain. Production change discarded; do not repeat or attribute a primitive-only speedup. All observations and generated code remain retained.

profile.scope: Separate restored current Encode8 warm JPEG CPU sampling; workload loops include warmup/calibration. Not parity timing.
profile.attributionRule: Match method names before the first parenthesis; parameter type names are excluded. Inclusive method matches overlap; they are not additive primitive costs.

assemblyControls.scope: Existing actual package compared with built profile project assembly; child build directory is cleaned by BenchmarkDotNet. Source inventories and child build log accompany the trace.

nextPrimitive: Share the first horizontal SIMD product across independent vertical-frequency accumulators in JpegTransform.Forward while preserving every original binary64 coefficient bit, each y/x addition order, work/cancellation/admission and existing fallback. No reassociation or new heap scratch.
uncertainty: One short rejection screen is not independent parity certification. The profile includes warmup/calibration workload samples and is not a speed ratio. Match exact method names before parameter lists. Inclusive method matches overlap and are not additive. The encoder leaf includes inlined work; it does not isolate component construction. Other measured, unmeasured and unmatched directions remain open. The stock MemoryStream screen passed its pre-run quietness check but failed its post-run check; it remains a rejection observation. Its two earlier attempts failed before launching any benchmark child. No parity certification or retained codec speedup follows.
